notes: The level-0/POS_DEAD descriptor gate is shared with quit and is proven by the existing command-gate fixture (R2/R5b/R5c).
An empty fixed review buffer emits only the exact header and separator; the same vehicle also proves the command's pager-facing result (R1/R3/R5e).
Two updates are rendered oldest-first because C inserts at slot 0 and traverses slot 24 down to slot 0 (R1/R3/R5e).
Trailing words are ignored by do_review and do not alter the rendered history (R1/R2/R5e).
Review replaces a speaker name with Someone invisible only when the stored invisibility level exceeds the viewer level (R1/R3/R5e).
The fixed 25-slot review array drops the oldest entry after overflow, preserving the C window (R3/R5e).
The actor receives the review output through the descriptor pager; no peer is present in the vehicle, matching C's actor-only page path (R1/R3/R5e).
